description: This file implements the Metal-based (Apple GPU) version of the hardshrink activation function for tensors in the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for performing soft thresholding using Metal compute shaders, and registers the function within PyTorch's library for the Metal backend.

classes.name: MetalTensorImpl
classes.description: A tensor implementation tailored for Metal GPU tensors, parameterized with storage type.

methods.name: hardshrink_
methods.description: In-place implementation of the hardshrink activation function that modifies the input tensor.

methods.name: hardshrink
methods.description: Returns a new tensor after applying the hardshrink activation function to the input tensor.
